mapper.insert: INSERT INTO odin_formation_run_frames ( guid, run_guid, formation_guid, group_guid, task_guid, task_name, page_no, frame_no, queue_type, frame_status, priority ) VALUES ( #{frame.guid}, #{frame.runGuid}, #{frame.formationGuid}, #{frame.groupGuid}, #{frame.taskGuid}, #{frame.taskName}, #{frame.pageNo}, #{frame.frameNo}, #{frame.queueType}, #{frame.frameStatus}, #{frame.priority} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, guid, run_guid, formation_guid, group_guid, task_guid, task_name, page_no, frame_no, queue_type, frame_status, priority, instance_guid, claim_owner, claim_token, lease_expire_time, submit_time, finish_time, attempt_count, error_cause FROM odin_formation_run_frames WHERE run_guid = #{runGuid} AND page_no = #{pageNo} AND frame_status = 'Pending' ORDER BY frame_no ASC
mapper.sql: id, guid, run_guid, formation_guid, group_guid, task_guid, task_name, page_no, frame_no, queue_type, frame_status, priority, instance_guid, claim_owner, claim_token, lease_expire_time, submit_time, finish_time, attempt_count, error_cause
mapper.update: UPDATE odin_formation_run_frames SET frame_status = 'Submitted', instance_guid = #{instanceGuid}, submit_time = NOW(), attempt_count = attempt_count + 1 WHERE guid = #{guid}
